envType.description:
Atmosphere model(s); a list simulates several environments. Supported values:
- `standard_atmosphere`: RocketPy standard atmosphere (no wind).
- `standard_atmosphere_wind`: RocketPy standard atmosphere with custom average wind speeds and wind direction 90° (wind coming from East). 
    Requires `standard_atmosphere_wind_speeds`.
- `Windy`: RocketPy Windy forecast. Requires `windy_weather_models`.
- `custom_atmosphere`: CSV files generated by the weather export script. Requires `custom_weather_models`.
- `reanalysis`: RocketPy reanalysis file. Requires `reanalysis_file` and `reanalysis_dictionary`.
- `reanalysis_custom`: existing historical CSV files. Requires `reanalysis_csv`.

`reanalysis` and `reanalysis_custom` must be the only entry in the list.
envType.title: Envtype

reanalysis_csv.description: CSV filenames in the project folder keyed by weather model name, used with 'reanalysis_custom'.
reanalysis_csv.title: Reanalysis Csv

standard_atmosphere_wind_speeds.description:
Average wind speeds for the standard_atmosphere_wind environment [m/s]; the wind comes from the East (90°)
and varies over height by 10 % (OpenRocket's default turbulence intensity). One value is used for the whole altitude range.
Multiple values simulate several environments, one per value.

Variable: also accepts a list `[a, b, c]` or a range string `"start..stop:step"`; one flight per value.
standard_atmosphere_wind_speeds.title: Standard Atmosphere Wind Speeds

custom_weather_models.description: Custom weather model name(s), used with 'custom_atmosphere'.
custom_weather_models.title: Custom Weather Models

reanalysis_file.description: Reanalysis data file in the project folder, used with 'reanalysis'.
reanalysis_file.title: Reanalysis File
